transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello... um. Well, I suppose I'm here because of... a scar. On my wrist. I mean, I know it's probably not as bad as it looks to me, but... I don't know. When I'm at church, or playing bridge... I just keep feeling like everyone's eyes go right to it. Like it's the first thing they notice about me now.
Do you believe that others are noticing your scar more than they actually are, or have you ever felt that people are talking about it even when they aren’t?
I don't think so. I haven't actually heard anyone saying anything about it. It's just... I just feel like they might be looking at it. That's all.
Have you ever had thoughts that seem to come out of nowhere, or that you can't control, which cause you a lot of upset?
No... I don't think so. Not that I can think of, anyway.
Do you often feel very anxious or worried in social situations, like church or playing bridge, even when there’s no obvious reason to be?
Um... no. Not really. I've always been perfectly fine at those things. It's just... well, just what I mentioned before. But otherwise, no.
Do you ever feel that your scar looks much worse than it actually is, or that it draws more attention than it really does, even though others might not seem to notice it?

Well... I suppose. I mean, I know it's probably not as bad as it looks to me. But... when I'm at church, or playing bridge, I just keep feeling like everyone's eyes go right to it. Like... like it's the first thing they notice about me now.
Do you find yourself thinking about this scar, or any other part of your appearance, a lot more than you used to, even when you're not around others?

Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean, obviously I see it when I look in the mirror to get ready, but... I don't just sit around thinking about it when I'm home alone. I have plenty of other things to do. It's really just... what I said before, about when I'm out.

Do you ever feel so self-conscious about your scar that it affects how you interact with people or makes you avoid certain situations altogether, even though you know they might not actually be paying attention to it?

Um... I suppose it has a little. I... well, I've been a bit late turning in some of my bookkeeping work lately. And... I guess I've skipped a couple of my volunteer commitments, like for choir and the community theater. It's just... I get so caught up trying to make sure my wrist won't be noticed, and... well, it just makes things difficult.
Would you say that your concern about your scar has caused you a lot of distress or has interfered with your daily life, such as your work, hobbies, or relationships?

Well... like I just mentioned, yes. It's... it's gotten in the way of my bookkeeping. And the choir and theater things. I just... I don't like doing them if I have to constantly worry about people seeing my wrist. So... yes, I suppose it interferes.
Do you worry about any other parts of your appearance in a similar way, or is your concern mostly about the scar on your wrist?
No... it's really just the scar. I don't... I don't worry about anything else like that. Just my wrist.
How long have you been feeling this way about your scar? Has it been weeks, months, or longer?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't exactly kept track of it. Just... a while, I suppose.
Can you estimate how long you've been feeling this way about your scar? Has it been weeks, months, or longer?
I... I really couldn't give you an exact time. Like I said, I haven't kept track of it. Maybe months? I'm sorry, I just... I don't know for sure.
When you’re worried about people noticing your scar, is it mainly because you’re afraid they’ll think less of you or judge you negatively?
I... I don't really know. I just... I don't like people looking at it. I haven't really thought about exactly what they might be thinking. I just prefer they don't see it.
When you're worried about people noticing your scar, is it mainly because you're afraid they’ll think less of you or judge you negatively?
I... well, like I just said, I really couldn't tell you. I haven't tried to analyze it like that. I just... I just don't like it when people look at it. That's really all there is to it.
Have you ever had intrusive or unwanted thoughts specifically about your scar that cause you significant distress or interfere with what you're doing?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I go to work and do my job just fine. It doesn't stop me from getting things done or anything like that. I just... I prefer not to think about it at all, really.
Have you ever had any other concerns or unusual experiences that are similar to how you feel about the scar, such as thinking something is wrong with you that others don’t seem to notice?
No... I don't think so. It's really just the scar. I don't... there isn't anything else like that, if that's what you're asking. I'm perfectly fine otherwise.
Have you ever felt the need to hide or cover up the scar, such as by wearing certain clothes or avoiding specific activities, even if it’s not directly related to being judged by others?

I suppose I do... sometimes. I mean, before I leave the house, I might check my wrist in the hall mirror. Just a few times, maybe try a different sleeve length or put on a bracelet to cover it up. I've asked my husband a couple of times if it looks obvious, but... he always says it's barely there anyway. So, yes, I guess I do try to cover it.
Would you say that the way your scar looks is a bigger concern for you than it seems to be for other people who see it?

I suppose. I mean... I know it's probably not as bad as it looks to me. But... well, when I'm at church, or playing bridge... I just feel like everyone's eyes go right to it. Like it's the first thing they notice about me now. So... yes.
Have you ever felt this way about anything else related to your appearance, even briefly, that might suggest this isn’t just about the scar?
No... not really. Like I said earlier, it's just this scar. I don't... I've never really worried about anything else with how I look. Just this.
Have you ever felt self-conscious or worried about any other aspects of your appearance in the past, even briefly, such as your face, hair, or body shape, even if it wasn't as noticeable as the scar?
No... like I just said, it really is only the scar. I've never been one to worry much about my hair or my shape. It's just this.
